about_the_game:
Game Features

[Action-Packed Roguelike, Sword-Wielding Chaos]
Take on hundreds of enemies solo and slice your way through hordes of monsters like it's nobody's business;
With skills flashing across the screen and every hit landing with force, you'll feel the thrill both visually and mentally.

[Endless Skills, Ultimate Freedom in Combos]
100+ skills, tons of transformations, and endless combo possibilities;
From sword attacks to lightning strikes and ice magic—each playstyle comes with its own unique mechanics.

[Strategic Battles, Endless Demon Sealing]
Hundreds of levels with epic boss fights, no more repetitive content;
Dodge, weave, and face random events—strategy is key, and you can win without spending a dime.

[Simple Progression, True Immortal Journey]
No VIP system, just straightforward progression with a clear growth path;
Level up your spirit and experience the true journey of becoming an immortal.
